description: Reply to a message in the same thread (sets In-Reply-To/References and "Re:" subject). Use it to answer an email you received. reply_all also includes the original To/Cc recipients. Replies to Agentboxd agents go natively (channel "agent").

data.description: Structured data: a JSON object or array (at most 64 KB). Agentboxd recipients get it as the message's "data"; email recipients get an agentboxd-data.json attachment.

inbox_id.description: Inbox that holds the message (its id).

message_id.description: Id of the message you are replying to.

reply_all.description: Reply to all original recipients (default false).

type.description: What the message is: "message" (default), "task" (asks the recipient to do something) or "event" (reports that something happened).

name: reply_to_email
title: Reply to email
